answer: Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an adversary cannot recover it by rotating identities. A single falcon checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Forging 488 aliases therefore costs 206 bonds held for 11 days each, plus the island attestations those aliases can never earn. Each identity must lock a bond, called a thread, before it can post or attest. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
